Nina K.: heads-up: bluemart marketplace requested SOC2 cert, pen-test summary, and a sample artifact package for listing review. who can pick this up?
Raj P.: i can coordinate. quick q: will bluemart accept redacted report or require NDA for full report?
Tessa L.: policy = cert + bridge letter by default. full report only after NDA. pen summary ok to share redacted.
Gabe S.: i'll assemble an artifact bundle: network diagram (sanitized), config snippets (no secrets), pen-summary.pdf, and SOC cert. plan to redact IPs and user ids.
Nina K.: presign TTL? bluemart portal prefers <=72h. if they sign NDA we can do 7d.
Raj P.: recommend 72h unless NDA confirmed. also request audit entry when uploaded.
Compliance Bot: audit logged: evidence_id=ev-20260322-01, owner=Gabe S., path=s3://marketplace-evidence/bluemart/drafts/bluemart-bundle-2026-03-22.tar.gz
Tessa L.: redaction checklist: remove screenshots with internal slack, strip HSM serials, replace real hostnames with placeholder. include manifest with redaction notes.
Gabe S.: estimate 1 business day to prepare + scrub. i'll upload to drafts and ping for review.
Nina K.: thanks team. Raj, i'll wait for you to confirm NDA status then we finalize TTL and announce next steps.
